data.one_liner: A custom pull-to-refresh widget with liquid animations and transitions for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a LiquidPullToRefresh widget that wraps a vertical scroll view to display a custom animated refresh indicator with physics-based spring effects.
use_when: You want a custom pull-to-refresh design inspired by Ramotion's concepts.
You are using a vertical scroll view like a ListView or GridView.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard platform-native refresh indicators.
strengths: Visually appealing liquid animation and spring effects.
Customizable colors, border width, and animation speed.
weaknesses: Can only be used with a vertical scroll view.
